user_facing_summary:
Shading plan for `war_orc`
Brief: Hard one-step shadows on celeste metal war armor and dark green skin; closed great helm. Light top-front +X-up.

Light: top-front / +X-up
Rules: one_step_darker, no_gradients

Overall:
One-step darker hard bands only. Local flats: green #244820 → #1A3518; celeste metal #8FA8B8 → #6A8494; highlight metal leave #B8D0DC; banner red #C42828 → #9A1E1E. No gradients. Eyes and violet mark stay clean.

Per design layer (paint shadows on design/layers/ only):
  - upper_arm_far: Far pauldron underside and armpit band darker; far side slightly darker overall.
  - lower_arm_far: Bracer/gauntlet underside and cuff rim darker celeste.
  - upper_leg_far: Far cuisse underside/back edge darker.
  - lower_leg_far: Greave underside and under boot sole darker.
  - torso: Breastplate underside and belt fold darker; back/left edge of plate slightly darker; banner lower edge darker red; leave violet symbol clean; pole underside darker.
  - head: Closed great helm: darker band under brow/visor rim, underside of dome, lower jaw rim. Keep red eye pixels clean. Neck green if visible: under chin darker.
  - upper_arm_near: Pauldron underside and lower plate rim darker.
  - lower_arm_near: Bracer/gauntlet underside and cuff rim darker celeste.
  - upper_leg_near: Near cuisse underside band darker.
  - lower_leg_near: Greave underside and under boot sole darker.

Shade palette (one darker step from local flat color):
  - off_white (#DEC1B5) → shadow_beige (#A08884)
  - shadow_beige (#A08884) → muted_plum (#291A1F)
  - deep_red (#790F19) → muted_plum (#291A1F)
  - muted_plum (#291A1F) → muted_plum_alt (#3D2334)
  - muted_plum_alt (#3D2334) → near_black (#0E151C)
  - near_black_alt (#17171D) → near_black (#0E151C)
  - near_black (#0E151C) → near_black (#0E151C)

Apply with MCP paint tools only (fill_rect / draw_line / paint_pixels / paint_from_commands) on design layers — hard 1px–2px bands, no gradients, no Shell/PIL. Do not rewrite base geometry. Eyes live on the naked base head layer — shade design/head clothing only; do not clear or flood the head in a way that strips base eyes from compose underlays. Then compose_character (or re-compose). If this matches, say OK; otherwise revise the plan.
